bfl_overview_hint: Hover over a total for its account breakdown.
bfl_bank_identity_tip: [Country.GetName] holds its own treasury, assets and obligations. These totals belong to the bank, separately from your state treasury. Merchant Finance specializes in trade and corporate lending; Overseas Investment specializes in ventures and companies. A bank chooses one permanent specialization.
bfl_bank_status_tip: Operating: new business is permitted when its other requirements are met. Cash under pressure: available cash is exhausted. Withdrawals queued: unpaid withdrawal requests suspend new business. Insolvent: liabilities exceed assets. In resolution or Closed: ordinary business is restricted. Existing claims remain recorded.
bfl_cash_tip:
#T Treasury cash#!
Gold currently held by the bank.

Total cash: [Country.GetFixedPointCurrencyValue('gold')|2]@gold!
Protected cash: [GuiScope.SetRoot(Country.MakeScope).ScriptValue('bfl_protected_cash')|2]@gold!
Available cash: [GuiScope.SetRoot(Country.MakeScope).ScriptValue('bfl_free_cash')|2]@gold!

Protected cash reserves 25% of liabilities remaining after queued withdrawals, the full withdrawal queue, a 25 gold operating buffer and committed cash. Available cash is treasury cash less that reserve, with a minimum of zero. Protected cash is a required reserve; it can exceed the cash actually held.
bfl_assets_label_tip:
#T Total assets#!
Cash and recorded assets owned by the bank.

Treasury cash: [Country.GetFixedPointCurrencyValue('gold')|2]@gold!
Loan portfolio: [Country.MakeScope.GetVariable('bfl_native_credit_value').GetValue|2]@gold!
Inventory: [Country.MakeScope.GetVariable('bfl_inventory_value').GetValue|2]@gold!
Projects: [Country.MakeScope.GetVariable('bfl_project_value').GetValue|2]@gold!
Total: [GuiScope.SetRoot(Country.MakeScope).ScriptValue('bfl_assets')|2]@gold!

Loans, inventory and projects are recorded asset values, not cash available to spend. Principal repayments exchange a loan asset for cash; they do not create profit.
bfl_liabilities_label_tip:
#T Total debt#!
Obligations recorded in the bank's accounts. This is separate from your state's native loans and bonds.

Deposit principal: [GuiScope.SetRoot(Country.MakeScope).ScriptValue('bfl_deposit_principal')|2]@gold!
Credited deposit interest: [GuiScope.SetRoot(Country.MakeScope).ScriptValue('bfl_deposit_interest')|2]@gold!
Notes outstanding: [Country.MakeScope.GetVariable('bfl_notes_outstanding').GetValue|2]@gold!
Other payables: [Country.MakeScope.GetVariable('bfl_other_payables').GetValue|2]@gold!
Total: [GuiScope.SetRoot(Country.MakeScope).ScriptValue('bfl_liabilities')|2]@gold!

Queued withdrawals of [GuiScope.SetRoot(Country.MakeScope).ScriptValue('bfl_withdrawals_due')|2]@gold! are already part of deposit claims and are not added a second time.
bfl_equity_label_tip:
#T Bank equity#!
The residual value belonging to the bank's owners after its obligations.

Assets: [GuiScope.SetRoot(Country.MakeScope).ScriptValue('bfl_assets')|2]@gold!
Less total debt: [GuiScope.SetRoot(Country.MakeScope).ScriptValue('bfl_liabilities')|2]@gold!
Equity: [GuiScope.SetRoot(Country.MakeScope).ScriptValue('bfl_equity')|2]@gold!

Recorded state units: [Country.MakeScope.GetVariable('bfl_state_units').GetValue|2]
Total ownership units: [Country.MakeScope.GetVariable('bfl_total_units').GetValue|2]
Capital headroom: [GuiScope.SetRoot(Country.MakeScope).ScriptValue('bfl_capital_headroom')|2]@gold!

Negative equity means insolvency. Capital headroom is equity above 10% of assets, with a minimum of zero; distributions are limited by both this headroom and available cash. Equity is not the amount that can immediately be withdrawn.
bfl_equity_debt_tip:
#T Bank equity and debt#!
Up to twelve actual monthly settlement snapshots. Green is assets minus liabilities; red is the bank's total liabilities. Both use the same automatically scaled gold axis, including negative equity. Samples run from oldest on the left to latest on the right. Hover over a sample for its value and accounting month. State loans are not included in this bank history.
bfl_state_bonds_tip:
#T State bond capacity#!
Outstanding native state bonds: [GetPlayer.GetNumBonds]
Maximum native bond slots: [GetPlayer.GetDoubleModifierValue('max_bonds', 'max_bonds_modifier')|0]

These are your state's bonds, separate from the bank's deposits, equity and other liabilities. The capacity includes native base slots and bond-capacity modifiers. Selling a bond also requires the native borrowing conditions.
bfl_funding_title_tip:
#T Deposits and capital#!
A deposit transfers state cash to the bank and creates a repayable claim. A capital subscription purchases ownership units and can lose value. Both transfer existing gold; neither counts as bank profit.
bfl_deposit_1_tip:
#T Demand deposit#!
Transfer 100 gold from your state treasury to the chartered bank. The bank owes the principal plus credited interest; request repayment with Withdraw.

New-account annual rate: [Country.MakeScope.GetVariable('bfl_demand_rate').GetValue|%2]
Interest is credited monthly with cent carry. Each account keeps its accepted rate. Requires an operating bank accepting deposits, a free account slot and 100 state gold.
bfl_deposit_2_tip:
#T Term deposit#!
Transfer 100 state gold to the bank for twelve months.

New-account annual rate: [Country.MakeScope.GetVariable('bfl_term_rate').GetValue|%2]
Interest is credited monthly; principal and credited interest become withdrawable at maturity. Unlocked by native Banking research, the permitted age, a free account slot and an operating bank accepting deposits.
bfl_withdraw_tip:
#T Withdraw matured state deposits#!
Request repayment of your state's demand accounts and matured term accounts. The bank pays principal and credited interest from available cash. Unpaid amounts remain recorded in the withdrawal queue and suspend new business. Foreign accounts and unmatured term deposits cannot be withdrawn by this action.
bfl_buy_capital_tip:
#T Subscribe bank capital#!
Transfer 100 state gold to purchase new bank ownership units. Units are priced from positive bank equity per existing unit. This increases bank cash and paid-in capital, rather than profit. Unlocked by native Banking research, capital-table space and an operating bank accepting this business. Capital is exposed to losses and cannot be withdrawn as a deposit.
bfl_deposit_policy_title_tip:
#T Rates for new deposits#!
Choose the annual interest rate accepted by new demand accounts.

Current offer: [Country.MakeScope.GetVariable('bfl_demand_rate').GetValue|%2]
Term-account offer: [Country.MakeScope.GetVariable('bfl_term_rate').GetValue|%2]

Existing accounts retain the rate agreed when they opened. Monthly credited interest increases the bank's liability and reduces its retained earnings; it does not move cash until paid.
bfl_rate_0_tip: Offer 0% annual interest on new demand deposits. Existing demand accounts and the separate term-account rate remain at their accepted rates.
bfl_rate_1_tip: Offer 1% annual interest on new demand deposits. Interest is credited monthly with cent carry. Existing demand accounts keep their accepted rates.
bfl_rate_2_tip: Offer 2% annual interest on new demand deposits. Interest is credited monthly with cent carry. Existing demand accounts keep their accepted rates.
bfl_distribution_title_tip:
#T Profit distribution#!
Choose the share of eligible realized profit reserved for dividends.

Current payout share: [Country.MakeScope.GetVariable('bfl_payout_ratio').GetValue|%0]
Losses still to offset: [Country.MakeScope.GetVariable('bfl_loss_carryforward').GetValue|2]@gold!
Last total funded dividends: [Country.MakeScope.GetVariable('bfl_dividend_paid').GetValue|2]@gold!
Last state dividend: [Country.MakeScope.GetVariable('bfl_state_dividend_paid').GetValue|2]@gold!

Losses are offset first. Payment is limited by available cash and capital headroom, then divided among recorded owners by units. Unidentified founders' shares remain retained. Deposits, subscriptions, borrowing and principal repayments are not realized profit.
bfl_payout_0_tip: Retain all eligible realized profit. No new dividend is paid under this policy; retained profit supports liquidity and equity.
bfl_payout_25_tip: Allocate up to 25% of eligible realized profit to dividends after losses. Available cash, capital headroom and recorded ownership still limit payment.
bfl_payout_50_tip: Allocate up to 50% of eligible realized profit to dividends after losses. Available cash, capital headroom and recorded ownership still limit payment.
bfl_facility_title_tip:
#T Debt facility mandate#!
The state's standing instruction for bank-backed borrowing. Off requests no scheduled borrowing. Debt first prioritizes debt funding; Buffer requests funding for a forecast cash shortfall.

Last requested: [Country.MakeScope.GetVariable('bfl_facility_requested').GetValue|2]@gold!
Last funded: [Country.MakeScope.GetVariable('bfl_facility_paid').GetValue|2]@gold!

The native bond funding connection is unavailable in this build. These buttons record the mandate only; they do not issue a loan, sell a bond or move gold. A selected mandate therefore pays zero until execution is available.
bfl_facility_0_tip: Turn off the standing debt facility mandate. No scheduled bank funding is requested. Existing obligations remain payable.
bfl_facility_1_tip: Record a debt-first funding mandate for the state. Native bank-backed bond execution is unavailable, so this currently records policy without issuing debt or moving gold.
bfl_facility_2_tip: Record a buffer mandate to fund forecast cash shortfalls. Native bank-backed bond execution is unavailable, so this currently records policy without issuing debt or moving gold.
bfl_safeguards_title_tip:
#T Liquidity and safeguards#!
Available bank cash: [GuiScope.SetRoot(Country.MakeScope).ScriptValue('bfl_free_cash')|2]@gold!
Protected cash requirement: [GuiScope.SetRoot(Country.MakeScope).ScriptValue('bfl_protected_cash')|2]@gold!
Queued withdrawals: [GuiScope.SetRoot(Country.MakeScope).ScriptValue('bfl_withdrawals_due')|2]@gold!

Recapitalization supplies state capital. Suspending deposits stops new account funding while preserving existing obligations.
bfl_recapitalize_command_tip:
#T Recapitalize with 100 gold#!
Transfer 100 gold from the controlling state's treasury to the chartered bank. The rescue contribution adds 100 state ownership units and paid-in capital. It is not bank revenue. Requires the live charter controller and at least 100 state gold.
bfl_suspend_command_tip:
#T Suspend new deposits#!
Stop accepting new deposits and the funding actions that require deposit acceptance. Existing accounts, interest obligations and withdrawal requests remain recorded. This control does not close the bank or forgive its debts.
bfl_select_profile_tip:
#T Bank specialization#!
Open the specialization choice if this bank has not yet chosen a permanent profile. Merchant Finance and Overseas Investment open different research paths. A completed specialization cannot be replaced by this button.
bfl_purchase_native_loan_tip:
#T Purchase an estate loan#!
Ask the managed bank to take over an eligible native estate loan owed by your state. The bank pays the native purchase cost and becomes the creditor. Requires the native takeover conditions, available bank cash and capital headroom. This changes the holder of existing debt; it does not create a new loan.
bfl_buy_bill_tip:
#T Funded payment bill#!
Transfer 100 state gold to the bank for a funded payment bill. The bill is recorded as a payable, rather than bank profit or an unsecured loan. Requires Commercial Bills research, contract-table space and an operating bank accepting this business.
bfl_debt_tip:
#T Debt and credit#!
Permissions for lending, underwriting, restructuring and debt transfers. Each row has its own research, specialization, liquidity and execution requirements. A lock means new origination is unavailable; it does not cancel existing claims.
bfl_goods_tip:
#T Goods and trade#!
Merchant Finance instruments involving inventory, receipts, future delivery and margin. Recorded permission does not create goods or a trade route; physical execution is required.
bfl_ventures_tip:
#T Ventures and companies#!
Permissions for funded ventures, company investments, project security and bank-share transfers. These expose capital to investment risk and require the relevant research and specialization.
bfl_monetary_tip:
#T Monetary instruments#!
Later-age permissions for sovereign notes, secured liquidity, clearing and public support. Each requires its own authorization, backing and operating conditions.
bfl_sovereign_credit_tip:
#T Sovereign credit#!
A loan from bank cash to a landed state, with a repayment claim recorded as a bank asset. Requires an operating bank and the native loan conditions. New loan execution is unavailable in this build.
bfl_bond_underwriting_tip:
#T Bond underwriting#!
Use bank funds to acquire newly issued sovereign bonds. Requires a native issue, an identified holder and sufficient funding. Native bank-funded issuance is unavailable in this build.
bfl_sovereign_restructuring_tip:
#T Sovereign restructuring#!
Renegotiate sovereign debt under the Debt Restructuring advance. Requires the permitted age, an operating bank and a supported native debt transaction. Native restructuring execution is unavailable in this build.
bfl_corporate_credit_tip:
#T Corporate credit#!
Lend to a recognized trade company. Requires Corporate Credit research, Merchant Finance and the Reformation age or later. New native company-loan execution is unavailable in this build.
bfl_debt_resale_tip:
#T Debt resale#!
Transfer a debt claim to an identified new holder for a funded price. Coupons and redemption must follow the new holder. Native claim-transfer execution is unavailable in this build.
bfl_commodity_inventory_tip:
#T Commodity inventory#!
Finance goods held for trade. Requires Commodity Investments research, Merchant Finance and the Discovery age or later. Physical goods purchase, custody and delivery are unavailable in this build.
bfl_warehouse_receipt_tip:
#T Warehouse receipt#!
Issue a claim against identifiable stored goods. Requires Warehouse Receipts research, Merchant Finance and the Absolutism age or later. Verified storage and goods execution are unavailable in this build.
bfl_commodity_forward_tip:
#T Commodity forward#!
Agree a funded future goods delivery. Requires Commodity Forwards research, Merchant Finance and the Absolutism age or later. Physical delivery and settlement are unavailable in this build.
bfl_margining_tip:
#T Margin and risk management#!
Require collateral and variation margin against changing commodity exposure. Requires Margining and Risk Management research, Merchant Finance and the Revolutions age. Goods-backed margin execution is unavailable in this build.
bfl_commenda_tip:
#T Commenda#!
Commit capital to a voyage or trade venture in return for a defined profit share. Requires Commenda research, Overseas Investment and the Discovery age or later. Native project execution is unavailable in this build.
bfl_company_equity_tip:
#T Company equity#!
Subscribe capital for an ownership share in a recognized company. Requires Company Equity research, Overseas Investment and the Reformation age or later. Native company issuance and holder settlement are unavailable in this build.
bfl_project_security_tip:
#T Project security#!
Secure a venture against identifiable project claims. Requires Project Security research, Overseas Investment and the Absolutism age or later. Native project collateral execution is unavailable in this build.
bfl_bank_share_transfer_tip:
#T Bank share transfer#!
Transfer recorded bank ownership units between funded parties. Requires Bank Share Dealing research and the Reformation age or later. This row reports permission; it does not itself execute a secondary share trade.
bfl_sovereign_note_tip:
#T Sovereign banknotes#!
Issue charter-authorized notes with verified backing. Requires Sovereign Banknotes research, a state charter and the Absolutism age or later. Note-sale proceeds cannot count as their own backing. Native note execution is unavailable in this build.
bfl_secured_liquidity_tip:
#T Secured liquidity#!
Obtain short-term cash against eligible pledged assets. Requires Liquidity Facilities research and the Absolutism age or later. Native collateral and refinancing execution are unavailable in this build.
bfl_clearing_tip:
#T Advanced clearing#!
Settle mutual payment obligations through a funded clearing process. Requires Advanced Clearing research and the Revolutions age. Native clearing execution is unavailable in this build.
bfl_public_backstop_tip:
#T Public financial backstop#!
Authorize chartered financial support under Public Financial Backstops research in the Revolutions age. This row reports permission; it does not supply a free guarantee, mint gold or execute a rescue. A funded support transaction must be available separately.
